basic_profile.bio: An Edmonton local who loves sharing knowledge about the city and its surroundings. I'm a freelance writer focusing on lifestyle and wellness topics. I'm passionate about intuitive eating, which I discovered through personal health challenges. In my free time, I binge-watch 'Sister Wives' and explore nootropic options. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, often after dinner. I'm single and living with my two cats. I enjoy hiking, cooking, and learning about sustainable living.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in journalism, which has honed my research and writing skills. My interest in intuitive eating stemmed from health issues that led me to self-study nutrition and wellness. My engagement in online discussions about 'Sister Wives' has expanded my understanding of different family dynamics.
